decision.title: Chunked asset upload raises the effective file size, not the request ceiling
decision.rationale: Issue #126. Video/audio past the 100 MB one-shot cap uploads as a chunked session (chunk-start / chunk / chunk-finish / DELETE) with fixed 16 MiB chunks, so Bun's global MAX_REQUEST_BODY never rises. Reassembled ceiling 512 MiB = desktop sync push/pull cap; ASSET_SESSION_BUDGET 1 GB -> 4 GB. Untrusted-origin controls: fixed sizes, <=4 open sessions, budget reserved at start and always released, sniff on the reassembled stream via the shared consumeAssetStream core, idle TTL sweep, scratch under _state/asset-chunks (never assets/). Static paths in CANVAS_SAFE_API + canvas routes + hub manifest; hub mirrors on chunk-finish at both doors (isAssetWriteCompletion). S3 mirror streams from disk. One client (asset-upload.ts) for drop/paste, AssetPicker and native picker; native picker returns a token and the page reads raw ipc::Response slices instead of a JSON byte array. Rejected: raising the default cap (A), only exposing the env override (B), messaging-only (D). decision.title: DDR-248 addendum: chunk-session reservation is atomic; sessions bounded by empty/max-age TTLs; cross-site refused
decision.rationale: Close-time security review (defender + attacker) found chunk-start checked the session cap and budget before an await and registered after it, so parallel starts overran both (up to ~50 GiB reserved in a cell). Fixed: check+register+reserve in one synchronous block with rollback; one write in flight per session (409 for a second write or a finish mid-write); 60 s empty-session TTL and 2 h absolute age on top of the 30 min idle TTL; 403 on Sec-Fetch-Site: cross-site for all chunk routes; ENOTEMPTY-tolerant teardown; ASSET_CHUNK_BYTES clamped to the one-shot cap; native picker tokens expire after 30 min idle, slices re-check size+mtime, max 2 concurrent reads. Follow-ups: per-process budget resets on cell restart (needs hub/S3 metering), no per-caller cap in cells, ~2x disk at finish, path-based picker re-open. Full text: .ai/archive/decisions/DDR-248-chunked-asset-upload-raises-effective-size-not-request-ceiling.md
